snippet.title: Trivia Murder Party 3 | Official Teaser | Play It Now in Early Access!
snippet.description:
CAMP IS IN SESSION. Trivia Murder Party 3 is available now in Early Access on Steam and Epic!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048060/Trivia_Murder_Party_3/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/trivia-murder-party-518ad2?lang=en-US

Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp with a new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

Jackbox main site: https://www.jackboxgames.com/
